name: nesys-world-model-benchmark
description:
NeSyS World Modeling Datasets
	

This dataset repo contains the JSONL dev/test splits used in the paper
“Neuro-Symbolic Synergy for Interactive World Modeling” (arXiv:2602.10480).

	
		
		Tasks and splits
	

This repository is organized as 3 tasks × 2 splits:

Tasks: plancraft, scienceworld, webshop
Splits: dev, test

Files live under data/<task>/<split>.jsonl, e.g. data/plancraft/dev.jsonl.
